name: cli-agent-runner
description: Run scoped Grok, Claude, Codex, or custom CLI workers with CLI Agent Runner and its Codex IAB Live Console. Trigger on CLI Agent Runner, Live Console, Grok/Claude CLI, custom runner JSON, or .cli-agent-runner continuation; excludes generic coding and ordinary official subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Run scoped CLI workers with an IAB Live Console.
interface.longDescription: CLI Agent Runner is an explicit process-runner workflow for scoped CLI workers. It bundles Codex, Claude, and Grok profiles, accepts additional or overridden profiles from runner JSON, invokes every profile through one validated command-and-arguments path, automatically owns server startup and URL handoff, streams emitted stdout/stderr or structured messages to a token-protected Codex IAB viewer, enforces a machine-checkable repository scope, and records execution, parent artifact-acceptance, and result-contract outcomes independently in a process-runner-result packet under .cli-agent-runner. It does not replace generic coding or ordinary official-subagent routing.
capabilities: Codex, Claude, And Grok CLI Worker Launch
Automatically Owned Token-Protected IAB Live Console
Provider-Neutral Text And JSON Event Streaming
Separated Execution, Artifact-Acceptance, And Result-Contract Outcomes
defaultPrompt: Use CLI Agent Runner to launch a scoped Codex, Claude, Grok, or configured CLI worker and return its process-runner-result.
Automatically open CLI Agent Runner Live Console in Codex IAB and stream a scoped Grok worker.
Add or use a custom CLI runner from JSON for this .cli-agent-runner task.
